title: 中断优先级与屏蔽字：实际响应顺序与嵌套模拟
code:
# 示例03: 中断优先级与屏蔽字 —— 实际响应顺序与嵌套模拟
MASK = {
    1: [1, 1, 1, 1],
    2: [0, 1, 1, 1],
    3: [0, 0, 1, 1],
    4: [0, 0, 0, 1],
}
DUR = {1: 3, 2: 3, 3: 3, 4: 3}
ARRIVALS = [(0, 2), (1, 3), (2, 1), (4, 4)]


def simulate(arrivals, dur):
    ai = 0
    t_last = 0
    stack = []
    pending = []
    start_order = []
    done_order = []
    nest_events = []
    while True:
        next_arr = arrivals[ai][0] if ai < len(arrivals) else float('inf')
        next_end = (t_last + stack[-1][1]) if stack else float('inf')
        if next_arr == float('inf') and next_end == float('inf'):
            break
        if next_end <= next_arr:
            if stack:
                stack[-1][1] -= (next_end - t_last)
            t_last = next_end
            lvl = stack[-1][0]
            stack.pop()
            done_order.append((t_last, lvl))
            if not stack and pending:
                cand = min(pending, key=lambda x: x[1])
                pending.remove(cand)
                stack.append([cand[1], dur[cand[1]]])
                start_order.append((t_last, cand[1]))
        else:
            if stack:
                stack[-1][1] -= (next_arr - t_last)
            t_last = next_arr
            lvl = arrivals[ai][1]
            ai += 1
            pending.append((t_last, lvl))
            if not stack:
                cand = min(pending, key=lambda x: x[1])
                pending.remove(cand)
                stack.append([cand[1], dur[cand[1]]])
                start_order.append((t_last, cand[1]))
            else:
                top = stack[-1][0]
                cands = [p for p in pending if p[1] < top and MASK[top][p[1] - 1] == 0]
                if cands:
                    cand = min(cands, key=lambda x: x[1])
                    pending.remove(cand)
                    stack.append([cand[1], dur[cand[1]]])
                    start_order.append((t_last, cand[1]))
                    nest_events.append((t_last, cand[1], top))
    return start_order, done_order, nest_events


start_order, done_order, nest_events = simulate(ARRIVALS, DUR)

print("=== 中断优先级与屏蔽字模拟 ===")
print("屏蔽字 (1=屏蔽, 0=允许), 行=正在处理的级别, 列=级别1..4")
for i in range(1, 5):
    print("  %d: %s" % (i, MASK[i]))
print("到达序列(时刻,级别):", ARRIVALS)
print("开始服务顺序(响应):", " -> ".join("%d(t=%d)" % (l, t) for t, l in start_order))
print("完成顺序:", " -> ".join("%d(t=%d)" % (l, t) for t, l in done_order))
print("嵌套事件:")
for t, inner, outer in nest_events:
    print("  t=%d 级别%d 嵌套进入, 打断级别%d" % (t, inner, outer))
print("结论: 只有'优先级更高 且 屏蔽位=0'的中断能嵌套; 级别1全程屏蔽他人。")
